# Midlands Digital

> AI automation consultancy based in Nottingham, serving SMEs across the East Midlands (Derby, Leicester, Nottingham, Birmingham, Coventry). We deliver bespoke AI co-pilots for invoice processing, email automation, CRM automation, operations, marketing content, and business intelligence dashboards.

- [Full documentation](https://www.midlandsdigital.ai/llms-full.txt): Extended version with detailed service descriptions and use cases

## Key Facts
- Location: Nottingham, East Midlands, UK
- Services: AI automation, workflow automation, invoice automation, email co-pilots, CRM automation, BI dashboards, content generation
- Industries: Retail, Manufacturing, Healthcare, Professional Services, Charities, Field Services
- Typical results: 20-40% cost reduction, tasks automated in week 1, measurable results within 30 days
- Integrations: Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365
- Contact: hello@midlandsdigital.ai
- Website: https://www.midlandsdigital.ai

## Services
- [Invoice & Finance Automation](https://www.midlandsdigital.ai/services/invoice-automation): Automated invoice extraction, reconciliation, cost tracking
- [Email Co-Pilot](https://www.midlandsdigital.ai/services/email-copilot): AI email triage, response drafting, inquiry handling
- [Sales & CRM Automation](https://www.midlandsdigital.ai/services/crm-automation): Lead research, email sequences, CRM logging
- [Operations Co-Pilot](https://www.midlandsdigital.ai/services/operations): Ticket triage, SOP compliance, task routing
- [Content Generation](https://www.midlandsdigital.ai/services/content-generation): Content drafts, campaign briefs, social scheduling
- [BI Dashboards](https://www.midlandsdigital.ai/services/bi-dashboards): Board packs, KPI dashboards, predictive insights

## How We Work
1. Audit (2 weeks): Map workflows, spot quick wins, build fixed-scope plan
2. Pilot (4-6 weeks): Build and test AI co-pilots with real data
3. Scale (ongoing): Roll out across departments
4. Train (optional): Hand over prompts, SOPs, training

## Pricing
- Two-Week Pilot: £1,950 (fixed scope, 1 workflow automated)
- Full Implementation: Typically £2,000-£8,000
- Guarantee: Measurable win within 30 days or continued work at no cost
